mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_event_outbox (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_version, event_type, topic, message_key, payload, dedupe_key, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, owner, claimed_at) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventVersion}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, #{payload}, #{dedupeKey}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{owner}, #{claimedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_event_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3))) OR (status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND claimed_at < NOW(3) - INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_event_outbox SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', owner = #{owner}, claimed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE t_event_outbox SET status = 'SENT' WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE t_event_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{backoffMicros} MICROSECOND), owner = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
